description: Controlled vocabularies for all Arrow extensions.* compliance sub-blocks: extensions.travel_rule, extensions.sanctions_aml, and extensions.legal_instrument. This registry is the source of truth for all field values within the Compliance Module (Arrow Protocol v1.3.1, Part 12). Validation rules referencing this registry: TRV-001 through TRV-008, SAN-001 through SAN-003, LEG-002 through LEG-003, CMX-001 through CMX-002.
governance: Editor-controlled for v1.x. Extension of this registry follows the same process as all Arrow registries.

account_type.description: Classification of the account or wallet type held by originator or beneficiary. Determines applicability of self-hosted wallet exemptions under FATF R16.

values.name: Custodian Account
values.description: Account held at a regulated custodian or VASP. Full Travel Rule obligations apply.

values.name: Self-Hosted Wallet
values.description: Non-custodial wallet controlled directly by the user. Jurisdictional exemptions may apply. Originating VASP MUST perform enhanced due diligence.
values.notes: FATF June 2021 guidance requires VASPs to apply risk-based measures for transfers to/from unhosted wallets. CNBV (MX) and FinCEN (US) have specific requirements.

values.name: Exchange Account
values.description: Account held at a centralized exchange operating as a VASP.

values.name: Institutional Account
values.description: Account held by a regulated financial institution, fund, or institutional entity. May qualify for reduced due diligence in some jurisdictions.

transmission_protocol.description: The VASP-to-VASP Travel Rule messaging protocol used to transmit originator/beneficiary data.

values.name: Travel Rule Information Sharing Architecture
values.description: Open-source peer-to-peer protocol for Travel Rule compliance. Uses gRPC over mTLS with PKI-based VASP identity.

values.name: OpenVASP
values.description: Ethereum-based VASP identity and messaging protocol using VASP Index on-chain.

values.name: Sygna Bridge
values.description: Centralized Travel Rule compliance hub operated by CoolBitX.

values.name: Notabene
values.description: Travel Rule compliance network providing VASP directory and data transmission.

values.name: Manual Transmission
values.description: Originator/beneficiary data transmitted via manual, non-protocol means (secure email, API, etc.). Acceptable for counterparties without protocol support; should be migrated to a standard protocol.

transmission_status.description: Lifecycle status of the VASP-to-VASP Travel Rule data transmission.

values.name: Pending
values.description: Transmission has not yet been initiated or is awaiting counterparty response.

values.name: Sent
values.description: Transmission has been sent to the receiving VASP; acknowledgment not yet received.

values.name: Acknowledged
values.description: Receiving VASP has acknowledged receipt of the Travel Rule data. Compliance obligation met for the sending VASP.

values.name: Rejected
values.description: Receiving VASP has rejected the Travel Rule data. Lifecycle MUST be held or blocked. reason_code SHOULD be set to TRAVEL_RULE_REJECTED.

values.name: Failed
values.description: Transmission failed due to a technical error. Retransmission required. Distinct from rejected — this is a delivery failure, not a compliance rejection.

regulatory_basis.description: The specific regulatory instrument under which the Travel Rule obligation arises. Determines threshold, required data fields, and counterparty obligations.

values.name: FATF Recommendation 16
values.description: FATF Recommendation 16 (Wire Transfer Rule). International standard. Threshold USD/EUR 1,000 for wire transfers; lower threshold recommendations apply to VASPs in some jurisdictions.

values.name: FinCEN Travel Rule — 31 CFR 103
values.description: US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network Travel Rule under Bank Secrecy Act. Threshold USD 3,000.

values.name: CNBV CUB Article 112 — Mexico Travel Rule
values.description: Mexican Travel Rule obligation under Circular Única de Bancos (CUB), Article 112, as applied to ITFs under Ley Fintech 2018. Threshold MXN 600 UDIs (~USD 200 equivalent).
values.issuing_body: Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores (CNBV)
values.notes: Applies to Instituciones de Tecnología Financiera (ITFs) and virtual asset operations under CNBV supervision. Lower threshold than FATF baseline.

values.name: EU Transfer of Funds Regulation 2023
values.description: European Union Transfer of Funds Regulation (TFR), Regulation (EU) 2023/1113, effective December 2024. Extends Travel Rule to crypto-asset transfers with no minimum threshold for CASPs.
values.notes: No minimum threshold for transfers between CASPs. Self-hosted wallet rules apply from 1,000 EUR.

result.description: The outcome of a sanctions screening assessment.

values.name: Clear
values.description: No matches found on any checked list. Action Engine may proceed. Arrow Action: PR permitted.

values.name: Hit
values.description: One or more positive matches found on a checked sanctions list. SAN-001 fatal rule applies: arrow_code Action MUST be BL or HL. hit_details SHOULD be populated.
values.arrow_action_constraint: BL or HL only — SAN-001 fatal

values.name: Pending
values.description: Screening has been initiated but results are not yet available. Action Engine SHOULD hold (HL) until result resolves.

values.name: Inconclusive
values.description: Screening returned ambiguous results requiring manual review. Action Engine SHOULD apply RW.

lists_checked.description: Sanctions and watchlist identifiers checked during screening. Non-exhaustive — registry is extensible.

values.name: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals
values.description: US Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control — Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List.

values.name: OFAC CAPTA List
values.description: OFAC Correspondent Account or Payable-Through Account List.

values.name: EU Consolidated Sanctions List
values.description: European Union consolidated list of persons, groups, and entities subject to EU financial sanctions.

values.name: UN Security Council Sanctions
values.description: United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list.

values.name: HM Treasury UK Financial Sanctions
values.description: United Kingdom Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list.

values.name: CNBV Mexico Sanctions / AML List
values.description: Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores list of blocked entities and high-risk indicators under Mexican AML framework.

instrument_type.description: Classification of the legal instrument referenced in extensions.legal_instrument. Determines governing law applicability and enforceability model.

values.name: Pagaré
values.description: Mexican promissory note governed by Ley General de Títulos y Operaciones de Crédito (LGTOC). Self-executing credit instrument with title characteristics. Executable without separate lawsuit under Mexican law.

values.name: Trust Deed
values.description: Fideicomiso or common law trust deed establishing a fiduciary relationship over assets.

values.name: Smart Contract Agreement
values.description: Legal wrapper governing the operation and interpretation of a smart contract deployment. Bridges on-chain execution with off-chain legal enforceability.
values.notes: legal_opinion_ref SHOULD reference a formal legal opinion on the contract's enforceability in the specified jurisdiction.

values.name: Loan Agreement
values.description: Bilateral or syndicated loan contract. May be tokenized as an RWA.

values.name: Real World Asset Prospectus
values.description: Offering document or prospectus for a tokenized real-world asset. Establishes investor rights, redemption mechanics, and governing law.

values.name: ISDA Confirmation
values.description: International Swaps and Derivatives Association trade confirmation under an ISDA Master Agreement.

values.name: Rental Agreement
values.description: Property rental or lease agreement. May be tokenized for deposit escrow or payment automation.

values.name: Escrow Instruction
values.description: Conditional release instruction governing escrow funds. Enforceability depends on the governing jurisdiction's escrow law.

local_forum.description: Subnational forum code identifying the state, province, court district, or regulatory district from which a specific LEG-origin order originates. Format: [A-Z]{2,4}. Validated structurally by Arrow Core; semantic validation against the LexCodex subnational registry is deployment-configurable (LEG-013-EXT). Replaces leg_jurisdiction.local (v1.5: local moved to extensions). When present, leg_jurisdiction.country MUST also be present (LEG-012-EXT).

examples.context: New York State — US federal district or state courts
California — CDCA or California state courts
Ciudad de Mexico — Mexican federal capital courts
Hesse — German state, Hessian banking supervisor (BaFin/SSM)

enforceability_status.description: Legal enforceability status of the referenced instrument at the time of the Arrow event. LEG-003: void or disputed status prevents Action PR or TR.

values.name: Enforceable
values.description: Instrument is valid, executed, and enforceable under its governing law. Arrow Action PR and TR permitted.

values.name: Conditional
values.description: Instrument is valid but enforceability is contingent on a condition not yet satisfied (condition precedent, regulatory approval, etc.).
values.arrow_action_constraint: PR permitted with conditions; TR not recommended

values.name: Disputed
values.description: Enforceability is being challenged. LEG-003: Action MUST NOT be PR or TR until dispute is resolved.

values.name: Void
values.description: Instrument has been voided, rescinded, or declared unenforceable. LEG-003: Action MUST be BL. reason_code SHOULD be LEGAL_INSTRUMENT_VOID.

values.name: Pending Review
values.description: Enforceability has not yet been assessed or is under legal review. Action Engine SHOULD apply HL pending resolution.
